descs.t: Early voting in person is underway in South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado, and Donald Trump is telling voters to return mail ballots immediately or vote in person. He has also posted endorsement slates for Senate, governor and House races from Texas to Alaska. We walk through the states he named and the races he is backing.

Donald Trump has turned his feed into an early voting drive, urging voters in South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado to vote now and posting full slates for races in Texas, Virginia, North Carolina, Nevada and more. Early votes are already coming in. We look at where he is pushing hardest and why the early vote matters to his side.

Early voting is underway and Donald Trump is calling on Republicans to stop waiting: return the mail ballot now or go vote in person. From Ken Paxton in Texas to the governor races in Arizona and Nevada, he has named the candidates he wants elected. We break down the slate and what is at stake if his voters stay home.

intro.plain: Early voting in person is now underway in South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado, and President Trump is telling voters to return mail ballots immediately or go vote. He has also posted endorsement lists for races from Texas to Alaska. So let me ask the chat: have you already voted early, or are you waiting for Election Day?
intro.mid: President Trump has turned his posts into an early voting drive. South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona, Colorado, all open now, and he is posting full slates of candidates state by state, Texas, Virginia, Nevada, Alaska. That tells you how much his side is counting on the early vote. Chat, which race on his list worries you the most?
intro.bold: Early voting is open and President Trump is not being subtle: return your mail ballot now or go vote in person. He has named his candidates in state after state, Ken Paxton in Texas, Andy Biggs in Arizona, Joe Lombardo in Nevada. If his voters stay home, those races are in play. Chat, tell me your state and whether you have voted yet.

hook.plain: Early voting in person is now underway in South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado. President Trump is telling voters to act now. Here are the states and the races he named.
hook.mid: President Trump is posting candidate slates state by state while early voting opens. That tells you exactly where his side thinks this election will be won or lost. Let's look at the list.
hook.bold: Return the ballot now or go vote in person. That is President Trump's message as early voting opens. Here are the races he is asking them to win.

descs.t: Virginia state Senator L. Louise Lucas, the Democratic President Pro Tempore of the Virginia Senate, has been arrested and indicted on federal charges including drug trafficking, money laundering and racketeering conspiracy, the Justice Department says. Prosecutors say she and six others were part of an alleged $4.5 million marijuana enterprise. We go through the charges and what the Justice Department has said.

Louise Lucas, one of the most powerful Democrats in Virginia, is charged with racketeering, bribery, drug trafficking, money laundering and a firearms offense. Her lawyer calls it political payback, while Attorney General Todd Blanche says the department does not do political paybacks. We look at what prosecutors allege and what it means for Virginia Democrats.

Virginia Senate leader Louise Lucas is in federal custody, and prosecutors say an FBI wiretap caught her calling it "our last chance at generational wealth." She is the same lawmaker who pushed to redraw Virginia's congressional maps. We break down the alleged $4.5 million marijuana enterprise and the charges she now faces.

intro.plain: Big news out of Virginia. State Senator Louise Lucas, the Democratic President Pro Tempore of the Senate, has been arrested and indicted on federal charges, drug trafficking, money laundering and racketeering conspiracy. Prosecutors say she and six others ran an alleged $4.5 million marijuana enterprise. Chat, did you see this coming?
intro.mid: Louise Lucas, one of the most powerful Democrats in Virginia, is now charged with racketeering, bribery, drug trafficking and money laundering. Her lawyer says it is political payback. Attorney General Todd Blanche says, and I quote, we don't do political paybacks. Chat, do you buy the political payback defense?
intro.bold: Virginia's top Democrat in the state Senate is in federal custody. Louise Lucas is charged with racketeering, bribery and running an alleged $4.5 million marijuana enterprise, and prosecutors say a wiretap caught her talking about generational wealth. This is the lawmaker who pushed to redraw the maps. Chat, should she resign today?

hook.plain: Virginia state Senator Louise Lucas has been arrested and indicted on federal drug trafficking and money laundering charges. Here is what the Justice Department says she did.
hook.mid: Her lawyer calls it political payback. The Attorney General says they don't do paybacks. Here is what prosecutors allege Louise Lucas actually did.
hook.bold: "This is our last chance at generational wealth." Prosecutors say that is Louise Lucas on an FBI wiretap. Now she faces RICO, bribery and drug charges. Here is the case.
